full_judgment: 3. In the plaint of partition suit, it was stated that the land measuring an area of 59 decimals appertaining to CS Khatian No. 572, Plot No. 522 of Mouza-Sutrapur and the land of Khatian No. 512, plot No. 523 measuring an area of 23 decimals of land i.e. in total 82 decimals of land was purchased by the plaintiffs father Abdul Bari by kabala deed dated 26-1-28. Thereafter, he started to construct his dwelling house on the land and at the time of said construction of dwelling house he took 1/4th cost of construction from his elder brother, Keramat Ali, the predecessor of the defendant No. 1 and the plaintiffs father himself spent 12 mutes cost incurred towards the construction of the said homestead. Thereafter, both of them began to live in the said homestead. An area of 11 decimals of land of plot No. 522 and area of 23 decimals of land of plot No. 523 belonged to Lal Mohammad. The plaintiff's father got from the southern part of the suit plot No. 523 from Lal Mohammad by way of exchange.
